findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. `trees` includes the main checkout in a normal repo (`story.py:790-799`), so this condition calls `merged_before_weeks` even when every story and fix is finished. That makes an extra GitHub search when its separate cache is cold, including immediately after `board --json` has warmed the PR cache; the board itself requests older merges only for unfinished stories with older parts (`board.py:585-588`). The extra search can restore the latency this fix is meant to remove.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. `lists()` expressly excludes the `merged:*..` search made by `merged_before_weeks`. The finished-item and board-then-next assertions use that filtered list, so they pass when `next --json` makes the extra GitHub call at `nextstep.py:209`. The named command-level proof therefore does not detect this violation of the no-extra-calls requirement.
